text: Calibre Audio Library is a national charity providing a subscription-free service of unabridged audiobooks for anyone with a print disability, such as dyslexia, MS, a visual impairment or brain injury. In order to use the Calibre Audio Library, please create an account at calibre.org.uk and login with your account at my.voxmate.com. People with sight disabilities all over Europe may register for an account. The membership costs a one time fee of 35 pounds, with a 3 month trial also available for free.
